_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_ops" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("op_type" IN ('trip_start', 'trip_result', 'ad_reward', 'spend_jenehat', 'spend_bonat', 'use_booster', 'comeback_gift', 'settings_update', 'tutorial_gift', 'story_progress', 'claim_request')), "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "jenehat_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bonat_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fuel_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reason" TEXT NULL, "ref" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("content_version" >= 1), "fuel_max" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fuel_max" >= 1), "fuel_regen_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fuel_regen_minutes" >= 1), "max_earnings_jenehat" INTEGER NULL CHECK("max_earnings_jenehat" >= 0), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK("sync_status" IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected')), "sync_reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallet" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "jenehat" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("jenehat" >= 0), "bonat" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("bonat" >= 0), "fuel" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fuel" >= 0), "fuel_counted_from_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fuel_unlimited_until_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory" ("booster_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("booster_id" IN ('change_bag', 'wake_all', 'ledger_peek', 'traffic_jam')), "count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("count" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("booster_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ownership" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('item', 'vehicle', 'chapter')), "sku_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL, "acquired_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "acquired_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "sku_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_progress" ("trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "best_stars" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("best_stars" BETWEEN 0 AND 3), "best_time_ms" INTEGER NULL, "plays" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("plays" >= 0), "first_completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trip_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_session" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "unfinished_start" TEXT NULL, "unfinished_trip_id" TEXT NULL, "unfinished_content_version" INTEGER NULL, "unfinished_max_earnings" INTEGER NULL, "unfinished_started_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "unfinished_revived" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("unfinished_revived" IN (0, 1)), "unfinished_traffic_jam_ads" INTEGER NULL, "last_result_start" TEXT NULL, "last_result_outcome" TEXT NULL, "last_result_earnings" INTEGER NULL, "last_result_doubled" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("last_result_doubled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projection_base" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "after_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('new_player', 'server_snapshot')), "state_version" INTEGER NULL, "taken_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clock_anchor" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "anchor_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_elapsed_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "boot_count" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('device', 'server')), "latest_trusted_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_record" ("start_txn" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "definition_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "params_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("start_txn"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_record_command" ("start_txn" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "command_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("start_txn", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_intent" ("request_txn" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_txn" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('use_booster')), "booster" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("request_txn"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('none', 'active', 'deleted')), "player_id" TEXT NULL, "providers" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "driver_level" INTEGER NULL, "first_open_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "restored_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_info" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "received_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "server_time_ms" INTEGER NULL, "state_version" INTEGER NULL, "content_version" INTEGER NULL, "client" TEXT NULL, "entitlements" TEXT NULL, "daily" TEXT NULL, "comeback_claimable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("comeback_claimable" IN (0, 1)), "comeback_claimed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "comeback_answered_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "display_name" TEXT NULL, "tutorial_granted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tutorial_granted" IN (0, 1)), "scenes_seen" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "requests_claimed" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "first_session" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "opening_done_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "scenes_due" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "scenes_seen" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "fuel_lesson_done_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "step_reached" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("step_reached" BETWEEN 0 AND 8), "done_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ledger_ops_sync ON ledger_ops (sync_status, seq)
